text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends a u-turn prohibition on Brimwood Boulevard, between Sandhurst Circle and Amanda Drive. Prohibiting u-turns will provide a safer environment for all road users along this section of Brimwood Boulevard located adjacent to Brimwood Boulevard Public School and Our Lady of Grace Catholic School.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited westbound and eastbound u-turn movements at all times on Brimwood Boulevard, between Sandhurst Circle and Amanda Drive.
